text: Gardening involves more than just planting seeds or nurturing plants; it requires attention to several essential elements. Watering the plants first is crucial to support their growth and establish a healthy root system. After watering, pruning is necessary to remove dead or weak branches and encourage new, healthy growth. The next step is to fertilize and feed the plants, providing them with the necessary nutrients for optimal health. Finally, it is essential to prune the plants regularly to maintain their shape and promote air circulation, which helps prevent disease and pest issues. By following these simple yet effective practices, gardeners can create a thriving and beautiful garden.
